description_ko: 거대한 단일 태엽 바퀴가 몸체를 이루는 비인간형 정원 기계. 바퀴 안의 파란 꽃 유리함과 전방 가위턱이 중심이다.

references.role: Original Flora materials and garden identity only: one blue flower in glass, garden-cap canopy, curly axle motif, pruning shears, ivory/brass/teal. No human anatomy lock.
Clockwork spring drum, ceramic shell and rendering construction reference only. No human body or previous rejected candidate anatomy.

refinement.change: Remove only the inherited star on lower blade; preserve entire wheel machine.

visual_qa.silhouette: Exactly one large vertical brass-spoked winding wheel, one contact patch, no arms/hands/legs/feet/human torso or separate human head.
visual_qa.identity: Exactly one blue flower with green stem inside clear brass-capped cylinder; original cap becomes canopy and face/curls are small flat axle relief only. Teal leaf-fender panels, ivory ceramic shell, brass winding drum/key.
visual_qa.mechanism: One readable connected two-blade pruning jaw with single round brass pivot and rods to the wheel frame. No loose scissors. One targeted refinement removed the lower blade star.
visual_qa.framing: Wheel rim, canopy, key and two blade tips fully inside canvas; no cropped major part.
visual_qa.method: Generated final preview and browser-decoded full review JPEG inspected. Saved PNG decoded 1536x1024 and SHA verified equal to actual generated source. Local PNG view_image may show a pale-strip rendering artifact; browser decode and JPEG inspection confirm the complete valid image.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view concept candidate; not selected or a validated 3D mesh.
